title: ASSET_SET_MANIFEST
$comment: The ingest/IBL-assembled set manifest — the python-minted appearance document. Producer python:artifacts/graphic/texture/set#TEXTURE_SET; descriptor source rasm/channels.proto message rasm.AssetSetManifest. Field names are snake_case because the vocabulary row binds the declaration to its generated message under preserved proto field names; every digest is the lowercase ContentKey wire spelling. Every roster this document spells resolves through the shared appearance vocabulary — a local re-spelling is the fork the fragment forecloses. The canonical-JSON projection is MessageToDict under preserving_proto_field_name, so proto3 fields at their zero default are ABSENT from the JSON asset while the wire bytes still decode them; required below therefore binds only the fields no legal instance zeroes.

vocabulary.$comment: Anchor for the shared fragment beside this seam directory.

planeRef.$comment: The shared planeRefProto triple as the canonical-JSON projection spells it: proto3 JSON renders every 64-bit field as a decimal string, so byte_length admits the string spelling beside the integer the struct declares. The triple's shape stays the fragment's — this def adds only the 64-bit JSON rendering.

mapEntry.$comment: One produced FILE's evidence row. `levels` is level-ordered under the shared planeLevels law: ONE triple for a self-pyramiding container whatever `mips` declares, one per level otherwise with length equal to `mips`. `tool`/`tool_version` are per-map facts — one set legitimately mixes the spawned ktx floor with an in-process leg — and the tool roster is producer-owned: ktx | imagecodecs | pyvips | openexr.

color_primaries.$comment: The PLANE's declared primaries datum, the khr_df_primaries_e spelling the KTX2 stamp reads; "" spells an undeclared datum on a pre-primaries document.

packEntry.$comment: `present` holds three flags in the pack row's own slot order; a false slot carries its channel neutral. `format` is always a 4-component storage-texel key.

iblEntry.$comment: Present only for the hdri and ibl kinds. sh9 rides the shared band order and layout; intensity and rotation apply ON READ, so re-orienting a dome re-keys no blob; up_axis is frozen z and a y value is a decode refusal.
